subject: MAP: Load test scheduling - traffic replay & sizing (follow-up)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: John Miller <john.miller@acme.com>, Sanya Rao <sanya.rao@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP next steps (load test milestone)

Thanks again for a productive conversation today - really appreciated the clarity on Acme's latency targets and QPS profile. Per our call, I'm attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the remaining milestones to get to pilot and production. The immediate item we agreed to prioritize is the load/performance test: traffic replay + dedicated capacity sizing.

Key ask (this thread): please confirm the primary contact for traffic replay (log access) and confirm a preferred week for the replay. Below is a short summary from the call and proposed next steps.

Call summary (high level):
- Target: pilot traffic with peak QPS ~1,200 and sustained 450 QPS (90th pct).
- Success criteria: p99 inference latency < 250ms on the dedicated configuration; error rate < 0.5%.
- Data flow: traffic replay using redacted logs from Acme staging (no PII) --> Redwood staging cluster (VPC peering).

Proposed MAP milestone: Load/performance test (traffic replay)
- Owner (Acme): Sanya Rao (staging infra, log access).
- Owner (Redwood): Vivek Kulkarni (inference sizing) and Aditya Rao (test orchestration).
- Dependencies: sanitized traffic logs, VPC peering completed, test harness credentials, target test window.
- Target schedule: Week of Jul 13, 2026 - aiming to complete replay + sizing in 3 business days.
- Deliverables: test report (QPS vs latency curves), recommended Dedicated sizing (GPU count / instance types), follow-up action items.

Attachments: map_draft_v2.xlsx (MAP with milestone checklist), traffic_log_20260628.tar.gz (placeholder - Acme to upload actual logs via secure link).

Next steps:
1) Sanya: confirm the log owner and upload timeline (we recommend anonymized replay logs by Jul 9).
2) Vivek/Aditya: we'll validate capacity assumptions and propose a dedicated sizing plan within 48 hours of receiving logs.
3) Marissa: coordinate test window with your ops team and confirm the date once logs are shared.

If that looks right, please reply with the contact + preferred week or suggest alternatives.

Thanks - Marissa

Subject: MAP v2 + proposed test runbook and responsibilities

John / Sanya - thanks for the quick replies and confirming Jul 13-15 tentatively. I've attached MAP v2 (small updates to dates and owners) and a short test runbook below to set expectations for the replay.

Test runbook (short):
- Phase 0: Prep (days -7 to -2): Sanya uploads sanitized logs to S3; Redwood validates format and runs redaction checks (hash-only tokens for any identifiers).
- Phase 1: Dry run (day 0 morning): small subset replay (5% of traffic) to validate harness and credentials.
- Phase 2: Peak replay (day 0 afternoon): ramp to target peak QPS (1,200) for a 2-hour window; sustained period at 450 QPS.
- Phase 3: Analysis (day 1-2): collect metrics (p50/p90/p99 latency, GPU utilization, error rates).

Responsibilities (concise):
- Acme: provide sanitized logs, validate VPC peering, nominate on-call for the replay window.
- Redwood (Vivek / infra): configure dedicated cluster, perform capacity sizing, run replay harness (Aditya).
- Deliverable: Test report + recommended dedicated sizing (GCUs/GPU count + instance types) by day 2 post-replay.

Security & redaction: Redwood confirms we do not persist raw logs beyond the test window; we keep extracted telemetry (metrics, anonymized histograms) for debugging only. We'll provide a short redaction checklist for your security team to review.

Next steps (api):
- Sanya: upload logs and share S3 link by EOD Jul 9.
- Redwood: once link available, we'll validate format within 24-48 hours and propose the specific test start time on Jul 13.
- Marissa: I'll send calendar invites for the 13th once the time is locked.

Thanks - looking forward to the run.

Marissa Cole

Marissa / team - quick internal note and sizing assumptions (copying external for visibility):

Prelim capacity assumptions for sizing: 
- Model: acme-gen-13B (decoder-only-ish; sequence len ~512 avg).
- Baseline perf (single A100-80GB equiv): ~120 seq/s at 1 request per seq with p95 ~ 180ms for small prompt; these are ballpark.
- Target peak QPS: 1,200 -> rough concurrent requests ~= (QPS * avg latency seconds) -> 1,200 * 0.18 ~ 216 concurrent requests.
- With continuous batching and KV cache warm, we estimate needing ~6-8 A100-equiv GPUs for a dedicated cluster to hit p99 <250ms at peak. If quantized 4-bit variant & optimized kernels, can target 4-6 GPUs.

Immediate asks for Acme/security: provide a sample of 1 hour of replay logs (anonymized) so we can run a quick micro-benchmark before full replay. That should be safe for security review.

Aditya - I'll need the replay harness to validate ramp curves and to capture GPU-level telemetry. Can you confirm we have the kbench config ready? If not, let's prioritize today so we can validate within 24-48 hours of log upload.

I'll prepare a short one-pager with sizing options (conservative vs optimized) and cost delta for Dedicated vs Hosted fallback. Target to send that the morning after the dry run.

Vivek Kulkarni
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
